name: AMS1117
full_name: AMS1117 1A low-dropout linear regulator (fixed and adjustable)
description: Ubiquitous 1A LDO in SOT-223, found on countless 3.3V breakout boards. Fixed grades (1.8/2.5/3.3/5.0V etc.) and an adjustable -ADJ grade set by a divider against the 1.25V reference. Dropout ~1.1-1.3V at 1A, so it cannot make 3.3V from 3.3V.

pins.name: GND/ADJ
pins.description: ground on fixed grades; ADJUST (feedback) on the -ADJ adjustable grade

pins.name: VOUT
pins.description: regulated output; also tied to the large metal tab

pins.name: TAB
pins.description: metal tab, electrically VOUT (tied to pin 2)

extra.Rth(JA): 90 C/W typ (SOT-223; varies 46-90 with copper area)

typical_application: On-board 3.3V rail for ESP/MCU breakouts from a 5V source. Adjustable grade: Vout = 1.25 * (1 + R2/R1) with R1 from OUT to ADJ.
gotchas: dropout is ~1.1-1.3V, much higher than a true modern LDO; you cannot regulate 3.3V from a 3.3V input
the tab is VOUT (tied to pin 2), not ground - matters for heatsinking and board layout
needs at least ~22uF on the output (electrolytic/tantalum/ceramic) for stability; many clones are marginal
pin 1 is GND on fixed grades but ADJUST on the -ADJ grade; check the suffix before wiring
